The '''KL-2B Battle Droid''' was a model of three-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A number of KL-2B units were among the dozens of droids that malfunctioned in the [[Network Security District]] and went on a rampage.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malfunctioning Hutt KL-2B Battle Droids appears as enemies on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
